packages.assessment: Track owns commercial grants; Gamification owns redemption and features consume effective benefits. Duration/quota/scope/composition are versioned and cannot bypass safety or replace base plans. Historical alternative owner is settled.
packages.remaining: Grant-specific benefits must be registered; no generic premium flag, automatic stacking or paid prize odds. Migration and replay fixtures remain unqualified.

packages.assessment: Consent immutable content/presentation/proof is separate from source eligibility and legal sufficiency. Source action binds actual presented version and proof; withdrawal preserves history. Sweepstakes official rules are source content, Consent supplies accepted-version proof.
packages.remaining: Jurisdiction, exact disclosure sufficiency, reconsent and retention are external policy. No enablement from browser permission, age acknowledgment, or enum presence.

packages.assessment: R066 finite semantic-intent matrix supplies source outcomes, current owner-resolved recipients, template versions and safe variables. Notification owns channels/attempts/credentials; source lifecycle never follows delivery. Undeclared historical alerts remain disabled, including CL09 optional integrity/legal notices absent registration.
packages.remaining: Selected channel/account qualification, legally sufficient notice evidence and executable template fixtures remain gated. BF-253 delivery result is transport evidence, never legal service or domain completion.

packages.assessment: Privacy owns generation/inventory/disposition/accounted completion; each source owns target facts, field mutation, serializers and receipts. Stable paginated target inventory and accepted versus completed effect prevent false completion. Search must return actual generation-qualified removal proof.
packages.remaining: Integrate pending exhaustive field/action/target disposition matrix (R070–073 work) before destructive activation. Current generic protocol does not prove all owner fields covered. Legal exemptions, retention and backups remain external; no guessed cascade.

packages.assessment: Provider owner executes deletion under an authorized Privacy disposition (or separately permitted typed moderation instruction); it keeps correlation and truthful effect receipts. Ops owns its own diagnostic adapter cleanup, not other providers.
packages.remaining: Provider deletion, retention, backup and jurisdiction capability evidence is external. Unknown deletion is pending/reconciling, not success. Retained shared assets require reference-aware owner disposition.

packages.assessment: Historical missing create/finalize handoff is resolved by Media createMediaUploadSession→completeMediaUpload→status/readiness. Privacy owns manifest/generation, Media exact ready version and bounded authorized access; incomplete upload/scan cannot mean export-ready. Audit owner exports remain Audit-owned.
packages.remaining: SH-087 historical naming is not authority: current protected serving is SH-127, with current Privacy authorization and durable sensitive-access proof. Schema/serializer/hash/revocation fixtures and storage/retention qualification remain gated.

packages.assessment: Hold evaluates typed target/action scopes and all independent active causes. Release needs fresh owner readiness plus current authority; it only prompts reevaluation. No payout, reward, restoration, service completion or review eligibility follows automatically. Candidate/Application/Resume absent Hold types are disabled.
packages.remaining: Complete and propagate target/action/release-readiness registration in pending R070–073 work. Existing R059 protocol alone is not exhaustive bilateral registry. BF-258 Search consumes source projection/visibility with Hold/restriction evidence, never infers publish from released Hold.

packages.assessment: Ops owns redacted diagnostic persistence and incident state; shared runner owns execution. Audit proof and business history are distinct from telemetry. registerHealthCheck already specifies component key/owner/timeout/classification/result callback and rejects duplicate key. Provider status translation stays source-owned.
packages.remaining: Runner/provider/observability adapter qualification and registered component fixtures remain activation gates. packages.assessment: Moderation owns cases/decisions; existing typed owners validate and apply restricted effects. CL01 generic executor and CL10 direct generic effects are disabled.

LegalNotice validity/timing/correspondence remain external. Implementation target/receipt fixtures still needed.

packages.assessment: Platform primitives provide idempotency/outbox/queue/locks/security and owner-local history/projections. Domain state and outbox commit atomically; network outside transaction; unknown effect reconciles before retry.
packages.remaining: Root placement and dependency sequencing must name shared infrastructure stewardship after reconciliation. Exact persistence adapters and per-owner fixtures are implementation qualification, not a second Module-owned queue.

packages.remaining: Qualify duplicate/out-of-order/removal projection fixtures; Professional cannot independently infer eligibility or recompute conflicting reputation truth.
